verdict.rationale: Casium has an organization-side offering: a dedicated attorney and case team, attorneys who file the company's visas and sign every filing, and a single dashboard for compliance and reporting across 90 countries. Its H-1B guide covers employer planning around the lottery registration. However, the evidence never documents H-1B registration or transfer filing, LCA compliance, or employer paperwork as specific services. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration and transfer service documentation, LCA/public-access-file compliance support, employer-side paperwork scope, independent corroboration.
